witness.branch: Pedestrian on or near a highway, street or road.
witness.quote: Exercise proper caution upon observing a pedestrian:
witness.reason: A separate control pedestrian can be observed on the fixed road during ego travel.
required_context: Establish actual observation independently of visibility, occlusion and line of sight.
Establish motor-vehicle classification, driver identity and control status.
Establish the pedestrian's classification and actual observation separately from visibility.
Identify separate ego and control-pedestrian identities and their routes.
Identify the motor vehicle, driver and physical-control relationship, and separately identify the pedestrian and both routes.
Preserve proper caution as unresolved; speed, clearance and time to conflict are physical context rather than legal cutoffs.
Record pedestrian position on or relative to the road without defining near.
Record road status, boundaries and pedestrian position. Using the on-road alternative avoids needing to interpret near.
witness.subject_reason: The available motor_vehicle_driver can be the driver of a qualifying motor vehicle.
